ideas.idea: Add LocalBusiness/Organization JSON-LD with name, phone and Falmouth location on the home page
ideas.why: The site has no entity markup, and the contact details exist only on the noindexed /contact page, so putting this on the home page is concrete and specific.

ideas.idea: Give the home page real content: what the harbour is, where it is and how to book
ideas.why: The home page has only a heading and one sentence, so adding substance helps readers and machines understand the site.

ideas.idea: Render the FAQ Q&A as visible page text, not only JSON-LD
ideas.why: The FAQ answers exist only in JSON-LD on index.astro and are not visible in the page body.

ideas.idea: Expand the prices page with sizes, seasonal rates and how to book
ideas.why: The page description promises sizes and seasonal prices but the page has only one price sentence.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod dates to the sitemap
ideas.why: This is standard sitemap advice with little effect on a 3-URL site.

ideas.idea: Generate the sitemap with @astrojs/sitemap and set site in the Astro config
ideas.why: The sitemap is hand-kept, the origin is hardcoded and there is no astro.config, and setting site would also help build per-page canonicals.

ideas.idea: Add charset, viewport and social tags, and a <main> element
ideas.why: This is boilerplate head and landmark advice that fits nearly any site.

ideas.idea: Link between pages, such as from the prices text to the contact page
ideas.why: The nav already links all three pages, so an extra contextual link has little effect.
